text: Onions and garlic are vital ingredients in many recipes. Begin by slicing the onions and garlic into small pieces, then place them in the pan and cook them over low heat for a few minutes until they have started to turn brown and release their aroma. This process is called caramelization and is one of the most important steps in preparing vegetables for cooking. Season your dish with salt, pepper, and any other desired spices to enhance the flavors of the onions and garlic.
